$comment: store-screenshots.json: one design for an app's store screenshots, rendered for every target (output size), locale and shot. Paths inside are relative to the config's own folder. Settings resolve theme, then the shot, then stores.<store>, then the target (each later one wins). Uses only the subset appstores_lib/schema.py validates.

captures.$comment: The captures' folder: <captures>/<locale>/<capture device>/<screen>.png (store-capture's layout). Default 'captures'.

out.$comment: Where the screenshots go: <out>/<locale>/<target>/<shot>.png, the layout store-listings reads. Default 'screenshots'.

primaryLocale.$comment: What every other locale's strings and captures fall back to. Must be in locales.

style.$comment: A screenshot-style.json (relative to this file): its theme and stores merge over these (the style wins) and its roles give shots with a role their layout. Locked once a baseline is approved (baseline.py).

design.$comment: The design folder: inspiration, directions, explorations, decisions.md and the approved baseline. Default 'design'.

targets.$comment: The output screens, by the screen names store-listing.json uses.

shots.$comment: The shots that share one canvas, in order (consecutive in 'shots').

background.$comment: An image across the whole canvas, or null for the theme's background.

seam.$comment: The keep-out margin either side of a seam, in --u (1% of a slot's width). Default 6.

stores.$comment: Overrides for every target of a store (apple, google).

strings.$comment: Words by locale and key; a locale missing a key falls back to primaryLocale's. *word* stresses a word in the accent colour; \n breaks a line.

deviceClass.$comment: A drawn frame's device class (frames.py CLASSES): its bezel and its screen's corner radius.

frame.$comment: A drawn frame, fitted to each capture (phone, tablet, watch, tv, laptop, desktop, or a class: phone-classic, foldable-outer, foldable-inner; phone-landscape and tablet-landscape still work: the orientation follows the capture), 'none', a path to a maker's device art (a PNG whose see-through screen is found, or with a JSON beside it giving its screen), or an object with options.

art.$comment: A maker's device art instead: a path (relative to the config) to a PNG with a see-through screen, used as it is.

maker.$comment: Whose art it is (apple, google, samsung...): the check holds it to that maker's terms. Unknown art is held to Apple's on Apple targets.

drawn.$comment: true only for art of the user's own that copies no maker's device.

screen.$comment: The art's screen in its pixels, when it can't be found from its alpha.

radius.$comment: The screen's corner radius as a fraction of its short side (the class's by default). It shrinks by itself where it would cut the capture's content.

bezel.$comment: The bezel as a fraction of the screen's short side.

buttons.$comment: Generic side buttons (phones and foldables). Never drawn on an Apple target.

cutout.$comment: A neutral camera cutout over the status bar: punch-hole or pill. Off by default; never drawn on an Apple target.

finish.$comment: The device's colour: dark (default) or light.

tiltAngles.$comment: A tilt's angles in degrees (y: the turn, x: the lean back, z: the roll) and perspective in u; the layout's own by aspect class where not given.

fold.$comment: The fold layout's settings: the hinge (auto: vertical unless the capture is clearly portrait), the angle between the halves (120 open; 70 with outer, so the lifted half's back shows), the outer display on that back (a capture screen id on the same capture device, or {capture, device}), and the view's turn and pitch in degrees.

placement.$comment: Where the words go: top or bottom.

sizePct.$comment: The caption's size as a % of the slot's width on a tall (portrait phone) slot; other aspect classes scale it (mid 0.66, square 0.78, wide 0.42).

floorPct.$comment: The smallest it may shrink to fit, on the same scale. A caption that won't fit at the floor fails the render.

font.$comment: A family from theme.fonts, or null for the system's.

plate.$comment: fullbleed only: solid (a rounded plate), scrim (a fade from the edge) or none.

case.$comment: Drawn as written (none, the default), in capitals (upper) or lower case (lower). The strings stay as written.

maxWidthPct.$comment: The caption's widest, as a % of the slot's width (the slot less its side margins by default): to match a measured set's line breaks.

kind.$comment: color (flat), gradient (palette.background2 to background), glow (soft light and the accent; the default) or image (src, cover).

dim.$comment: image only: a veil of palette.background over it, 0-1.

fonts.$comment: Fonts the project bundles (never fetched). Empty: the system's.

icon.$comment: The app's icon, shown on the hero.

hero.$comment: The hero's brand mark: logo (a path; any shape, a transparent PNG or SVG), fit wide (drawn at its own shape, no tile: a wordmark or a logo with words) or tile (as the icon), widthPct (its widest, in u; 56 by default). Over theme.icon.

tilt.$comment: The tilt layout's angles for the whole set (a shot's tilt object overrides them).

fold.$comment: The fold layout's settings for the whole set (a shot's fold overrides them).

caption.$comment: false: no words; an object: caption style overrides.

capture.$comment: The capture device whose captures feed this target.

device.$comment: The device class its drawn frames take (a foldable's outer or inner display, a 16:9 phone...), where the capture's shape doesn't say.

slot.$comment: Google only: the Play slot this target fills, when store-listing.json doesn't say.

role.$comment: With a style: the style's role (hero, feature, detail, accent, gameplay...) whose layout this shot takes when it gives none.

tilt.$comment: left or right, or an object with its side and angles (over theme.tilt).

fold.$comment: fold layout only: its settings (over theme.fold).

rect.$comment: [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the capture, from its top left.

pair.$comment: The second capture for 'pair': a screen id on the same capture device, or {capture, device, frame}.
